verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a documented official CLI that can plausibly run headlessly. It ships an official OCI container image, emits machine-readable JSON output to files, saves plans with -out for a later apply, accepts configuration through environment variables, and publishes a nightly build JSON 'for those who want to automate with tooling'. However, no evidence explicitly documents non-interactive or CI pipeline usage. missing for 10: explicit non-interactive/auto-approve flags, CI integration guides or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use official OCI container image available on GitHub Container Registry.
This allows for simultaneous capture of both human readable and machine readable logs.
You can use the optional `-out=FILE` option to save the generated plan to a file on disk, which you can later execute by passing the file to `tofu apply` as an extra argument.
For those who want to automate with tooling, `https://nightlies.opentofu.org/nightlies/latest.json` will be kept up to date with the latest build information.
